title: Scientists just found dinosaur blood that survived 115 million years
caption:
Scientists have found chemically confirmed traces of blood inside 115-million-year-old dinosaur bones. This discovery challenges our understanding of fossil preservation and the limits of biological decay.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists just found dinosaur blood that survived 115 million years

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261105224542.htm

Written in our own words. Credit for the research belongs to the study authors and their institution.
